stem: What revision, if any, should be made in sentence 34?

options.label: A
options.text: Some racers have described situations, unable to manage them on their own, and they helped them complete a part of the course that they didn’t know.

options.label: B
options.text: Some racers have described situations since people that they didn’t know helped them complete and finish a part of the course that they could not have managed on their own.

options.label: C
options.text: Some racers have described situations, and there were people they didn’t know who helped them, and they completed a part of the course that they could not have managed on their own.
